newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan firm increases Abu Dhabi oil field output.
newsitem.headline: Japan firm increases Abu Dhabi oil field output.

text.p: Japan's Abu Dhabi Oil Co Ltd said on Thursday it had increased daily output from an oil field it owns off Abu Dhabi earlier this month.

Daily output from the offshore Mubarraz oil field has been increased to 16,500 barrels per day (bpd) from 15,000 bpd by reopening an oil well which had been closed because of low productivity, an Abu Dhabi Oil spokesman said.
Output from the well resumed after the drilling of a horizontal pipe into the oil reserves, he said.
Abu Dhabi Oil is owned by Japanese oil firms and electricity utilities. The leading shareholder is Cosmo Oil Co Ltd, which has 51.1 percent interest.
